items.summary: Proposes no state income tax on the first $150,000 of income and a single 8% rate on income above that.
items.title: No state income tax on the first $150,000

citations.quote: NO STATE INCOME TAX ON YOUR FIRST $150,000
Income above $150,000 would be taxed at a simple 8% rate.

items.summary: Proposes suspending the Low Carbon Fuel Standard, reformulation requirements and other refinery regulations, and steps to increase California oil production.
items.title: Suspend fuel and refinery regulations ($3 gas plan)

citations.quote: Suspend the Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS), reformulation requirements, and other extreme and unnecessary refinery regulations: These compliance costs add roughly 40 cents per gallon.

Additional deregulation measures, including immediate steps to increase California oil production and the suspension of enforcement of SBX1-2 and ABX2-1, could reduce prices even further, by up to 25¢ per gallon.

items.summary: Proposes canceling state funding for high-speed rail as part of a plan to cut state spending below $300 billion.
items.title: Cancel state funding for high-speed rail

citations.quote: Cancel state funding for high-speed rail.
